\cvsection{Research profile}
\cvpara{Postdoctoral researcher at Beihang University working on privacy-preserving medical AI: federated and transfer learning for medical imaging, blockchain-enabled collaboration between institutions, and security for IoT and Android systems. First-author studies address PET–CT segmentation, LLM-enabled medical imaging, secure model aggregation and Android malware detection. Current work extends this line to large language models, from LLM-enabled diagnostics to execution-grounded multi-agent frameworks.}
\cvsection{Research interests}
\cvpara{Medical imaging AI and computer vision; Federated and transfer learning; Privacy engineering and blockchain; Large language models; IoT cybersecurity}

\cvsection{Selected first-author publications}
\cvpara{\fontsize{9.1}{12.6}\selectfont 78 scholarly works: 47 journal articles (8 as first author), 5 other peer-reviewed articles, 19 conference papers, 1 book chapter and 6 preprints. Full list from page~\pageref{sec:pubs}. Citations and h-index from Google Scholar, October 2026.}
\vspace{2pt}
\cvbullet{\textbf{LLM-enabled medical imaging.} Integrates LLM-based medical-image analysis with a blockchain-oriented AI framework (MID-LLM). \href{https://doi.org/10.1109/JIOT.2025.3583408}{IEEE Internet of Things Journal (2025)}.}
\cvbullet{\textbf{Multimodal PET–CT and medical AI.} Federated transfer learning for liver-lesion segmentation with multimodal feature integration. \href{https://doi.org/10.1016/j.artmed.2025.103245}{Artificial Intelligence in Medicine (2025)}.}
\cvbullet{\textbf{Federated brain-tumor segmentation.} Privacy-preserving blockchain-based federated learning applied to brain-tumor segmentation. \href{https://doi.org/10.1016/j.compbiomed.2024.108646}{Computers in Biology and Medicine (2024)}.}
\cvbullet{\textbf{Private model collaboration.} Blockchain and homomorphic encryption for medical-image model aggregation. \href{https://doi.org/10.1016/j.compmedimag.2022.102139}{Computerized Medical Imaging and Graphics (2022)}.}
\cvbullet{\textbf{Distributed CT-image learning.} Federated deep-learning methods for COVID-19 CT analysis. \href{https://doi.org/10.1109/JSEN.2021.3076767}{IEEE Sensors Journal (2021)}; 500+ citations.}
\cvbullet{\textbf{Secure CT-image sharing.} Blockchain-based CT-image sharing combined with AI-assisted image analysis for hospitals. \href{https://doi.org/10.1016/j.compmedimag.2020.101812}{Computerized Medical Imaging and Graphics (2021)}; 140+ citations.}
\cvbullet{\textbf{Android and IoT security.} Multimodal malware-feature analysis and secure information-sharing. \href{https://doi.org/10.1109/ACCESS.2019.2916886}{IEEE Access (2019)}; 150+ citations.}

\cvsection{Research software and datasets}
\cvbullet{\textbf{Federated learning for medical images}. PyTorch federated-learning pipeline for MRI and CT images, with a BraTS preprocessing example. \href{https://github.com/raja21068/Federated-Learning-For-Medical-Images}{Code repository}.}
\cvbullet{\textbf{Blockchain-based federated learning}. Federated training in which each round's global model is recorded as a block, demonstrated on MNIST. \href{https://github.com/raja21068/BLOCKCHAIN-FEDERATED-LEARNING-MINST-DATASET}{Code repository}.}
\cvbullet{\textbf{Android malware detection}. Multi-feature detection from static features and API-call sequences, comparing deep and classical classifiers. \href{https://github.com/raja21068/Android_Malware_Detection}{Code repository}.}
\cvbullet{\textbf{2D / 3D image annotation materials}. Project documentation and examples for 2D/3D image annotation workflows. \href{https://github.com/raja21068/annotation-tools-2D-3D-IMAGES}{Code repository}.}
\cvbullet{\textbf{Camera-based robotic mower}. Demonstration materials for camera-guided robotic mower navigation. \href{https://github.com/raja21068/-Wire-Free-Robotic-Lawn-Mowers-Embracing-Camera-Based-Innovation-for-Effortless-Lawn-Care}{Code repository}.}
